_comment: Doc 1 §2.4 resolveEnding() output maps here. Each ending is a room of the building (data/rooms.json `room`) the candidate walks into: stepping into its `zone` (or `autoSeconds` passing) takes the camera for the pull-back `shot`, then a dead-still `holdSeconds` before the card (Doc 2: a 4 second hold with no motion whatsoever). `routes` is the way on from a room that is not the ending's (the store's staff door, toward the waiting room). Doc 1 §6.4 for card text (textKey resolved via text.js against /text/endings.json). C4 is deliberately broken only on these cards -- 'you' appears exactly once per card.

flagOverlays.note: Doc 1 §2.5: if NEVER_SAT there is no chair for him at all in the boardroom.

RETAINED._note: Added post-launch (Doc 1 §9.1). The same boardroom as ASSIMILATION, a shorter pull-back that keeps the package in frame.
